Unusual evening, gratitude to the departure team
It was a good run

Sky calm, paws steady

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways had a cheerful stretch of departures and arrivals, and the mood stayed kind from check-in to handoff. Travelers appreciated the calm updates, and the team kept every pet moving with extra patience and a steady smile. One family with Cali left relieved, while another pair said the guidance made the whole journey feel lighter. <<FACT F028>> Staff also kept an eye on comfort details, from soft bedding to water breaks, and they made sure every concern was heard without fuss.

The same friendly approach carried into the lounge, where questions came in close together and were answered with care. <<FACT F014>> Supervisors listened closely when someone worried, and they helped turn a tense moment into a simple plan. That is the kind of day the desk likes best: practical, warm, and focused on the animals first. Companion Animal Travel Desk
